verdict.rationale: Exporting chat history and account data is a fair question for a personal AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no export of chat history or account data. The only data-portability mention is importing to-dos from Todoist, which is an import feature, not an export. Privacy concerns from the community do not bear on whether an export exists.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data
